exposure: Daily weight loss as a percentage of birth weight
cohort: 1865 term infants born in the Department of Obstetrics, Kunshan's First People's Hospital Affiliated to Jiangsu University and Huai'an Maternal and Child Health Care Center between May 2020 and June 2021.
finding: Neonates with a daily weight loss of more than 4% of birth weight or a total weight loss of more than 10% had higher hospitalization rates.
